systems.name: 5.1 GPU Compute Shader for Actor Ticks
systems.notes: Move bulk actor state updates to GPU compute shaders for massive monster counts. Ensure codepointer fallback remains functional.
tasks: Profile current CPU actor tick performance
Design compute shader for state transitions
Implement GPU-side codepointers for common actions
Seamless fallback to CPU for unsupported actions

systems.name: 5.2 Level Geometry Batching
systems.notes: Batch static level geometry into larger mesh buffers to reduce draw calls and improve rendering performance.
tasks: Batch wall and flat polygons per sector

systems.name: 5.3 LOD & Culling
systems.notes: Implement level-of-detail for distant things and frustum culling for actors.
tasks: Thing LOD: reduce model complexity at distance
Early-out for off-screen actors in tick loop
